page: Microsoft Azure E128ds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Edsv7 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture, delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system features 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It includes 7559 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage configurations. No GPUs are included in this instance type.

Benchmark data reveals top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores ranking in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, achieving top-tier status in both small-block cached and large-block uncached read/write operations. Single-core performance, however, sits in the average tier. The processor supports advanced vector and matrix extensions, including AVX-512 and AMX, which contribute to strong performance in extended instruction sets, cryptography, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.

Given its high resource density, the E128ds_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive memory footprints and high-speed local storage without the overhead of dedicated GPU hardware. It is highly suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and heavy multi-threaded data processing tasks. The instance is also capable of handling medium-to-large LLM prompt processing, though text generation speeds remain average.
